_readme: Copy to tools/sandbox.json and fill every <...> value. Keys are PRODUCTION identifiers found in the flow exports; values are your sandbox equivalents. See refdocs/guides/sandbox_runbook.md step 2.

replace.be7f2b53-cc4e-42b1-a043-a7d6a849ba42: <GUID of sandbox 'Control Template' list (Teams config, item ID 1)>
replace.287cbf2d-74fc-44ee-8bca-f26719b1feb3: <GUID of sandbox 'Report Duty Registration' list (flow 1 trigger)>

harness.library: <GUID of the sandbox Documents library (for trigger harnesses)>
harness.run_trigger_list: <GUID of sandbox 'Flow Run Trigger' list (flow 3 harness trigger)>

pa.account: <your sign-in address, as shown in the connection picker>

_excel_allowed_readme: Sandbox-only Excel values allowed through the production-ID guard by the baselinex/fixedx real-Excel targets ('me' = your OneDrive; the rest are mock-template/test-workbook table names).
